reason: Cycle 18 (f-nt1, 389.1), widened by f-m2 (review2 I-2, M-3, mentor D-316). 'magic' here is the non-Physical schools: 805770 triggers 501485 (Effect[0] aura 39 SCHOOL_IMMUNITY, EffectMiscValue 126 = Holy, Fire, Nature, Frost, Shadow and Arcane, every school but Physical, DBC checked) and the script applies ApplySpellImmune(805770, IMMUNITY_SCHOOL, 126); the verdict names that reading. Three scenarios, each with one cast route: Chilled Blood 35317 (Frost, one aura effect, slow) and Arcane Buffet 37133 (Arcane, direct damage plus a damage-taken aura), each cast three times by the dummy in the 3000 ms window (none may land) and again after the expiry (a real cast lands, the control that the cast route lands at all); Daze 38767 (Physical, one slow aura, cannot miss: Unit.cpp SpellHitResult) in its own scenario (review6 I-1: with Daze after Arcane Buffet its third cast fell on the 3000 ms expiry, and with Arcane Buffet last the same happened to it) is cast three times at 0, 500 and 1000 ms and must be present at the 1500 ms read, every cast and read inside the window (the Physical control). The harness set_aura placing each fixture before the cast is a fixture-existence read, not a cast route; the real-cast control is the post-expiry read. Shadow, Fire, Nature and Holy are the same 126 mask and not cast. Residual failure probability of a post-expiry control read: all three casts miss at about 4 percent each (Unit.cpp MagicSpellHitResult, equal levels, 96 percent hit) is 0.04^3 = 6.4e-5 per read, 1.3e-4 over the pair, under the 0.1 percent limit.
